recentItems.title: Should nepo babies embrace the label? | Engagement Party
recentItems.description:
Nepo babies have sparked debate for years, but chart-topping singer-songwriter Stella Lefty, who also happens to be the daughter of a billionaire, is reigniting the conversation. Audie and Ari debate how the rich and privileged should navigate fame and success — and they don't entirely agree. Plus, why an Ivy League dean wants you to be skeptical of the explosion of college admissions content online.

recentItems.title: Havana was the ‘city of lights’. It’s now pitch black
recentItems.description: Cuba is struggling through its worst energy crisis in living memory as the US-imposed blockade on oil continues. CNN’s Patrick Oppmann’s night drive through Havana reveals a city increasingly plunged into darkness, with exasperated residents enduring hot, sleepless nights without power.

recentItems.title: Vance calls out El-Sayed over remarks about his family
recentItems.description: During his GOP convention speech Thursday night, Vice President JD Vance criticized Democratic Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed for a recent remark he made about Vance and his family. #vance #gopconvention #abdulelsayed #cnn

recentItems.title: Construction surges at suspected Iranian nuclear site
recentItems.description: Pickaxe mountain, buried deep under granite, has seen a flurry of construction work this year, according to analysts from CSIS. But there are signs that the US is working to develop a "next generation penetrator" bomb to hit targets deeply buried underground. CNN's Davis Winkie breaks it down.

recentItems.title: What Republicans think about Trump's plan for $5k checks
recentItems.description: At the GOP midterm convention, CNN's Steve Contorno talked with skeptical attendees about President Donald Trump's vow to send $5,000 checks to American adults if Republicans win the Senate and House.

recentItems.title: 15-year-old is the only survivor after family fishing trip
recentItems.description: A 15-year-old boy who had been fishing with his brother and cousin in Alaska was rescued on Monday after their boat capsized the night before. The three boys were on an 18-foot fishing vessel near St. Lawrence Island when their boat overturned, according to a news release from the US Coast Guard.

recentItems.title: Is Trump's head-to-head programming against the NFL a fumble?
recentItems.description: For the second night in a row, President Trump’s GOP convention speech is going head-to-head against a major NFL game. Harry Enten joins Erin Burnett on why trying to compete with the league is "ridiculous" and a massive oversight for Trump.

recentItems.title: The FCC keeps another Talarico interview off late night
recentItems.description:
Jimmy Kimmel claims his show was forced to move an interview with James Talarico to YouTube due to FCC threats, a claim the agency disputes. However, an FCC commissioner tells CNN's Erin Burnett that the administration is using threats to intimidate media companies, raising serious questions about late-night television and the equal-time rule.

recentItems.title: Trump wants to give every American $5K, but there’s a catch
recentItems.description:
President Donald Trump vowed to pay every American adult $5,000 if Republicans retain their House and Senate majorities in November’s midterm elections – an extraordinary offer as he tries to keep his party in power. But he offered no details on how he would pay for such a move, which he equated to companies paying shareholders dividends and the extra $1,776 checks his administration issued to members of the military last year.

“Here is my promise: If the Republicans win the House of Representatives and the United States Senate, both of them,” Trump said, “I will issue a dividend to every adult citizen in the United States of America for $5,000.” He stressed that the payment — which he named “the Trump dividend” — comes with a condition: It must be spent in the United States.

The CNN Newsnight panel and the CNN This Morning group chat discusses this proposal and whether or not it can deliver a victory for the GOP.
